FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Rhythm & Stage Academy, we specialize in providing high-quality instruction in dance, drama, and music for students of all ages. Our operations include offering structured classes across various disciplines, led by experienced instructors. We prioritize the safety and well-being of our students by maintaining a facility that meets all safety regulations, including functional emergency exits and regular equipment maintenance. Furthermore, all staff members working with minors undergo thorough background checks to ensure a secure learning environment. We also implement comprehensive risk management plans, including clearly documented emergency response procedures, to prepare for any unforeseen events. Our curriculum is constantly updated and evaluated based on student feedback and industry best practices, ensuring that we provide a relevant and enriching educational experience.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, a student slipped and fell during a dance class, resulting in a sprained ankle. The total medical expenses amounted to $1,200. The claim was resolved within two months, and all necessary safety measures were reinforced in the facility to prevent future incidents.
